text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... My time... Aww, it hasn'timproved at all!
choice_data_list: Let's take a breather. Remember what I said?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... About rushing too much,<n>right? If I strain
too hard, my running<n>form will fall apart.
choice_data_list:
Right. So don't worry so much about your time for
now.

Right. So don't worry so much about your time for
now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I want her to become comfortable<n>with her running
first. She just needs<n>some training sessions
without any<n>heavy physical or mental stress.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I need to remember the form I had<n>before the
injury... right? Okay, I'll try!
choice_data_list: Good, but no rush. We'll build up a little at a time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy isn't fairly assessing<n>her own
abilities right now. But if she<n>can start to believe in
herself, I'm<n>sure things will come together!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Several days later...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I can move much more easily now...<n>even though
all I've been doing is<n>running at my own pace.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Right... I see now. I really don't have<n>to rush.
Trainer trusts in my abilities<n>as they are.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Meaning I... I should believe in<n>myself, too, at least
as much as<n>Trainer believes in me!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm... okay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day in the library, just before the<n>Tracen Meet,
Zenno Rob Roy is<n>looking over notes related to our
hero<n>search.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt in my mind. Trainersaid it wasn't her at the time, but...the hero has to be Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The date, the time, the track... They all<n>point to Kris S
and no one else.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I should tell Trainer. But I... don't want<n>to.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(But I have to. I'll race against Kris S<n>at the Tracen
Meet and inevitably<n>lose... then I'll share what I
learned,<n>and that will be that.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (So until then, I'll keep this secret...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tracen Meet is finally<n>here! Zenno
Rob Roy is off and<n>running...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, no! It can't be! Why'd I have a<n>late start today
of all days?!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Kris S, she's... getting farther and<n>farther away...
I'll lose sight of her at<n>this rate.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it... I can't win. I never stood<n>a chance. And
after all the help I got<n>training for this...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I... I'm the... protagonist?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what would happen if I won<n>against Kris
S today. Would I have a<n>story of my own? Then...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Even after the Tracen Meet... Evenwhen I reveal the hero's identity...maybe Trainer would continue towatch the story that I'm leading,forever after.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (That's what... I want!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There! It looks like Zenno Rob Roy is<n>making a
move for the front! But it's<n>the final stretch, and
Symboli Kris S<n>still has a huge lead!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Watch me, Trainer. You're the only<n>one who will
read my chronicle!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The main character of this story... is<n>me! Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I finally see it. That wild and<n>desperate, yet
determined, running...<n>She's the heroic figure I saw
that<n>day!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Haaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: She's getting close.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S powers forward just<n>before the
finish! She's fast! She's<n>really the greatest star of
the show<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she takes first place! An<n>outstanding victory by
Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A roar of applause erupts from the<n>crowd.
Everyone seems to have<n>eyes only for today's
winner.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I lost... Of course I did. There was<n>never any
chance for me. It's done,<n>then. I have to say it... I
have to give<n>up.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! Um, I... I know who your<n>hero is...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's—huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wha? But... but what do you mean?<n>What are you
talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, that was an impressive—oh,<n>you're
occupied.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kris S! I'm glad you're here.<n>There's
something I need to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So you see, it was on this day at<n>about four-thirty!
You were using the<n>outer turf track, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We had a joint training<n>session. It was
that day, though I'm<n>not certain of the time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Right, see? I knew it, because I saw it<n>with my own
eyes! Kris S was<n>definitely the hero there that day!
choice_data_list: Wait, you said a joint session?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy was training as well.
choice_data_list:
Rob Roy... Did you have your hair tied back that
day?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes... I did.
choice_data_list: And you almost fell but managed to save yourself?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to mention<n>embarrassing details
like that! Wait,<n>does that mean... You... And I'm...
What?!
choice_data_list: Rob Roy, I want to be your trainer for real!
Rob Roy, I want to be your trainer for real!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought. You're occupied.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I think I see. After that session, I<n>injured myself
and couldn't run well,<n>so you couldn't tell I was the
hero<n>you saw...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What a shock. So you've been...<n>watching me ever
since then.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember what I said<n>before? A tale only
becomes a heroic<n>epic when it's passed down as
legend.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... listen, Trainer. I promise, I won't<n>let you down.
I'll continue this tale of<n>mine until it's so great that
you want<n>to pass it on.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I want you to help me complete it.Let's make The Chronicle of ZennoRob Roy a legend!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the smile on her face, I can tell<n>she means
every word. So begins the<n>prelude of her long and
heroic epic.
